About

About This Site

Welcome to my personal portfolio and project showcase. This site features my work in systems programming, distributed systems, and various programming languages including Rust, Golang, and C/C++.

I'm passionate about building robust, scalable systems and exploring low-level programming concepts. My projects range from distributed message queues to operating system kernels, virtual machines, and developer tools.

  • Materialize CSS - UI framework
  • Netlify - Hosting and deployment
